rows.definition: Inkling2LoopConfig (internal/model/inkling2loop_spine.go): the pinned identity and geometry of a Thinking Machines inkling2_loop checkpoint, a looped MoE transformer whose stored layers 6..17 run three passes per token (48 layer visits from 24 stored layers). Its loop_config field (Inkling2LoopPasses) is the per-token layer-pass schedule: core_start, core_end, num_passes, gate_rank, is_varloop.
rows.distinction: A model-architecture layer-pass schedule inside one forward step, not a control loop: it has nothing to do with the agent loop, goal loop, super-loop, meta-loop or loop_count rows, which are process or orchestration loops. It is a load-time validated description that fak's native forward refuses to execute (UnsupportedInkling2LoopExecutionError).
